model: MolmoAct2 (SigLip ViT + Qwen LLM + flow-matching action expert), curriculum LoRA
provenance_correction_92pct: CORRECTED 2026-08-13: earlier docs referenced a '92%'. That figure was a 90-rollout SMOKE (30 tasks x 3 episodes) of a SEPARATE, barely-adapted checkpoint (liberoplus_ft_fp32/015000, ~0.013 epoch / 1.3% of one pass), NOT a full-benchmark result and NOT the curriculum-LoRA model tabulated in this file. It must not be posted as a target or an achieved score. It was demoted to a 'model-validity smoke' by dev policy on 2026-07-20.
external_context: Official LIBERO-plus leaderboard (CVPR2026 / arXiv 2510.13626): best = OpenVLA-OFT+ 79.6%, RIPT-VLA 68.4, OpenVLA-OFT 69.6, pi0-fast 61.6, pi0 53.6. MolmoAct2 curriculum-LoRA (~67-70%) sits mid-pack, above pi0/pi0-fast. The pi0.5 '~85.7%' figure is from a DIFFERENT paper (WAM survey, arXiv 2603.22078), not this leaderboard.
scope_notes: s4 (rank-128) and s5 (rank-256) = FULL 10,030-task runs, COMPLETE (MI355X-class GPUs; 184/184 shards each, verified 2026-08-14). Perturbation counts sum to 10,030.

s2 (rank-32) and s3 (rank-64) = COMPLETE stratified 1,673-task subset only (uniform stride per suite => proportional across the 4 suites + 7 perturbation categories + 5 difficulty levels). Full 10,030 runs for s2/s3 were intentionally SKIPPED per dev decision 2026-08-13 (subset is a representative estimator; the full-vs-subset gap on s4/s5 is <1 pt, validating the subset).
Head-to-head rank curve on identical FULL 10,030 basis: s1 67.2 -> s4 68.4 -> s5 69.6.
findings: On the identical FULL 10,030-task basis the rank curve is shallow and near-monotone: 67.2 (r16) -> 68.4 (r128) -> 69.6 (r256); +2.4 pt total from 16x the LoRA rank. Subset estimates (s2 68.6, s3 68.9) fall on the same shallow trend.

Full-vs-subset agreement is tight (s4: 68.4 full vs 69.2 subset; s5: 69.6 full vs 69.9 subset; <1 pt), confirming the 1,673 stratified subset is a reliable estimator and validating the decision to skip full s2/s3.
libero_10 (long-horizon) is flat ~31% on full at every rank (s1 30.9, s4 30.8, s5 31.7) => extra LoRA capacity does not fix the dominant long-horizon failure.
Biggest per-perturbation win from curriculum: Light Conditions +7-9 pt (75.9 -> 83-85 full) and Sensor Noise +4-5 pt (64.5 -> 69 full at r256).
Robot Initial States remains the weakest dimension at every rank (~53% full) and does NOT improve with rank; Camera Viewpoints / Objects Layout also stay low (~66%) and barely move.
By difficulty (full), higher rank sharpens the easy end (L1 75.6 -> 78.5) more than the hard end; L5 stays the floor (~50-52%) and is the single biggest bottleneck.

Context vs peers: MolmoAct2's ~68-70% is mid-pack on the official LIBERO-plus leaderboard (above pi0 53.6 and pi0-fast 61.6, ~OpenVLA-OFT 69.6), below OpenVLA-OFT+ 79.6. Top scores require perturbation-aware (mixed) fine-tuning, which this curriculum LoRA did not do.
